title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Rad Superdrop

paragraphs.text: The Rad Superdrop is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It's also a follow up to 2024's Fallout commander decks and the Equinox Superdrop drops. The Rad Superdrop became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on January 26, 2026.

This is the third Universes Beyond cross-over product based on the Fallout series , a media franchise of post-apocalyptic role-playing video games and later action role-playing games created by Tim Cain from Interplay Entertainment , published by Bethesda Softworks (BSW).
The release of this superdrop coincides with the start of the second season of the television adaptation of the game .

Buyers receive a foil alternate art Silver Shroud Costume promo card with art by David Szabo , for each $149 spent while supplies last. The original version of the card had appeared in Fallout (2024).
Non-foil versions of the Fallout: Beyond Vault 33 drop will become available for purchase in WPN game stores on April 17, 2026.
As an extra, each of the drops come with a surprise bonus card.
